_note: Curated HSN / SAC codes common in Indian (Tamil Nadu) retail with SUGGESTED GST rates as per the GST 2.0 rate structure effective 22 Sep 2025. Rates change by notification and depend on the exact goods (pre-packaged & labelled vs loose, composition, value per piece for garments / footwear): every business must verify the code and rate against the current CBIC rate notifications with its tax advisor before use. gst_rate_bp null = rate depends on value (see slab_rule_hint). Tobacco and pan masala also attract compensation cess until it ends.
source: Customs Tariff / GST rate schedules; GST Council 56th meeting decisions (Sep 2025)
